stem_book: Calculate the entropy change (in J K⁻¹) when 1 kg of water is heated from 27°C to 200°C, forming superheated steam, under constant pressure (1 atm, boiling point 100°C). Given: specific heat of water = 4180 J/kg·K, specific heat of steam = 1670 + 0.49T J/kg·K and latent heat of vaporization = 23 × 10⁵ J/kg.
reason: Print says 2000°C but the printed key 7522.50 is exactly the 200°C result (2000°C gives ≈ 11,026 J/K) — misprint corrected to 200°C; boiling point 100°C made explicit.
